highlights.title: Your no reads as a no
highlights.text: Press Deny and the step reads "You said no; nothing ran" in calm grey, not a red failed step. Real failures still stand out.

highlights.title: Replies come back in the order you asked
highlights.text: Send a few messages while a bot waits on an approval card, and the answers now come back in the order you sent them, so each one lines up with its question.

fixes: Switching the bot browser to another page's tab goes straight to that page, with no grey empty "Finished" card in between.
New kwnt run-check tells you whether any bot ran something without asking, or asked again after you said no.
Each browser tab's address bar shows its own page's address and title, even while the bot browses in another tab.
